articles.title: Japan's SBI Group is building Asia's first cross-border digital asset empire
articles.snippet: The securities giant announced today the consolidation of Singapore-based Coinhako as part of a rapid regional expansion that includes a tokenization partnership with Ondo Finance.

articles.title: Keyrock acquires BlockFills trading assets to expand institutional crypto business
articles.snippet: The deal adds institutional trading clients, derivatives expertise and regulatory licenses as Keyrock looks to deepen its presence in crypto capital markets.

articles.title: Stablecoin growth will erode bank deposits, says ECB’s Cipollone
articles.snippet: ECB’s Piero Cipollone said stablecoin adoption could erode bank deposits, but the digital euro will keep banks at the center of payments.

articles.title: UK sentences 2 hackers tied to $115M crypto ransom scheme
articles.snippet: The pair pleaded guilty after investigators linked them to the Scattered Spider cybercrime group, which US prosecutors say extorted dozens of companies.

articles.title: Ordinals advocate Leonidas proposes new Bitcoin client: ‘$DOG Mode’
articles.snippet: “Over time the economic incentives will drive $DOG Mode’s adoption and force Bitcoin Core to stop gatekeeping and allow these completely valid transactions,” said Leonidas.
